rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Living Logistics Policy Team - General Manager ), 044-201-4156

rows.source_ko: 국토교통부 (생활물류정책팀-택배서비스사업), 044-201-4153
rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Living Logistics Policy Team - Parcel Delivery Service Business ), 044-201-4153

rows.source_ko: 국토교통부 (생활물류정책팀-소화물배송대행서비스사업), 044-201-4158
rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Living Logistics Policy Team - Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Business ), 044-201-4158

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「생활물류서비스산업발전법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Development of the Living Logistics Service Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(택배서비스사업 등록증 등) ① 「생활물류서비스산업발전법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조제1항 및 「생활물류서비스산업발전법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조제3항에 따라 택배서비스사업을 등록하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 택배서비스사업 등록신청서를 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 국토교통부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다. <개정 2025. 1. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Certificate of Registration for Parcel Delivery Service Business, etc.) ① Any person who intends to register a parcel delivery service business pursuant to Article 5(1) of the Act on the Development of the Living Logistics Service Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 2(3) of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for registration of a parcel delivery service business in the form of Annex No. 1 to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. In this case, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act. <Amended Jan. 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제3조제1항에 따른 택배서비스사업 변경등록신청서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The application for change of registration of courier service business pursuant to Article 3 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제5조제3항에 따른 택배서비스사업 등록증은 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The courier service business registration certificate pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Act is in the form of Annex 3 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 국토교통부장관은 법 제5조제3항에 따라 택배서비스사업 등록증을 발급했을 때에는 별지 제4호서식의 택배서비스사업 등록대장에 그 사실을 기록하여 관리해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport issues a courier service business registration certificate pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall record and manage the fact in the courier service business registration ledger in the form of Annex 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(택배서비스사업 등록요건에 관한 사항의 신고) 법 제5조제4항에 따라 같은 조 제1항의 등록요건에 관한 사항을 신고하려는 택배서비스사업자는 같은 조 제1항에 따라 택배서비스사업 등록을 한 다음 해부터 매년 영 제2조제3항 각 호의 서류를 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 1. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Reporting of Matters Concerning Registration Requirements for Courier Service Businesses) A courier service business operator who intends to report matters concerning the registration requirementsunder Paragraph 1 of Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land , Infrastructure and Transport the documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree annually, starting from the year following the registration of the courier service business under Paragraph 1 of the Act. < Amended Jan. 17 , 2025 >

rows.source_ko: 제4조(택배서비스사업자의 지위승계 신고) ① 법 제13조제3항에 따른 택배서비스사업자 지위승계 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제5호서식의 택배서비스사업자 지위승계 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reporting of Succession of Status of Courier Service Provider) ① A person who intends to report the succession of status of a courier service provider pursuant to Article 13(3) of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport the Reporting of Succession of Status of Courier Service Provider in Form No. 5 of the Attached Form, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업 양도의 경우: 양도ㆍ양수 계약서 사본 등 양도ㆍ양수를 증명할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of a business transfer: Documents proving the transfer, such as a copy of the transfer agreement.

rows.source_ko: 2. 상속의 경우: 「가족관계의 등록 등에 관한 법률」 제15조제1항에 따른 가족관계증명서와 상속 사실을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of inheritance: A family relationship certificate pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Registration of Family Relations, etc. , and documents confirming the fact of inheritance

rows.source_ko: 3. 합병의 경우: 합병계약서 사본 등 지위승계를 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of a merger: Documents proving succession of status, such as a copy of the merger agreement

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 국토교통부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신고인이 제2호에 따른 서류의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 사본을 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a report under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the reporter does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraph 2, a copy thereof must be attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당된다)
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업자등록증
rows.text_en: 2. Business Registration Certificate

rows.source_ko: 제5조(택배서비스사업의 휴업ㆍ폐업신고서) 영 제7조제1항에 따른 택배서비스사업 휴업ㆍ폐업신고서는 별지 제6호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Notice of Suspension or Closure of Courier Service Business) The notice of suspension or closure of a courier service business pursuant to Article 7 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 6 .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(소화물배송대행서비스사업자의 인증신청서 등) ① 영 제10조제1항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자인증 신청서는 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Certification of Small Parcel Delivery Service Provider, etc.) ①The application for certification of a small parcel delivery service provider pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 7 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제10조제3항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자 인증서는 별지 제8호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of small parcel delivery agency business operator pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 8 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(인증심사대행기관 지정신청서 등) ① 영 제12조제2항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자 인증심사대행기관 지정신청서는 별지 제9호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Designation of Certification Examination Agency, etc.) ①The application for designation of a certification examination agency for small parcel delivery service providers pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제12조제3항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자 인증심사대행기관 지정서는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The designation certificate for the certification examination agency for small parcel delivery service providers pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 범죄경력조회) ① 영 제14조의3제1항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따른 범죄경력조회 요청서는 별지 제10호의2서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Criminal Background Check for Small Parcel Delivery Service Workers, etc.) ①The request form for a criminal background check pursuant to the first part other than each subparagraph of Article 14-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 10-2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제14조의3제1항제1호나목 및 같은 항 제2호나목에 따른 범죄경력조회 대상자의 동의서는 별지 제10호의3서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The consent form for a person subject to a criminal record check pursuant to Article 14-3, Paragraph 1 , Item 1 ( b) and Item 2 (b) of the same Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree is as Form No. 10-3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제14조의3제2항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따른 범죄경력조회 요청서는 별지 제10호의4서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The request form for a criminal record check pursuant to the first part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 14-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as Form No. 10-4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제14조의3제3항에 따른 범죄경력조회 회신서는 별지 제10호의5서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The reply to the criminal record inquiry pursuant to Article 14-3 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 10-5 .

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 17, 2025.]
[Formerly Article 7-2 was moved to Article 7-3 <Jan. 17, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의3(소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격 확인의 절차ㆍ방법 등) ① 법 제2조제4호나목에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자(이하 “소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자”라 한다) 또는 영업점은 법 제19조의4제1항에 따라 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등(소화물배송대행서비스종사자 또는 소화물배송대행서비스종사자가 되려는 자를 말한다. 이하 같다)의 운전자격을 확인하기 위하여 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등에게 다음 각 호의 서류의 제출을 요청할 수 있다. 다만, 법 제19조의4제2항에 따라 운전자격확인시스템을 통하여 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격을 확인할 수 있는 경우에는 그렇지 않다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-3 (Procedures and Methods for Verifying Driver Qualifications of Small Parcel Delivery Service Workers, etc.) ①A certified small parcel delivery service business operator pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 4, subparagraph ( b) of the Act ( hereinafter referred to as “certified small parcel delivery service business operator”) or a branch office may request the submission of the following documents from small parcel delivery service workers, etc. (referring to a small parcel delivery service worker or a person intending to become a small parcel delivery service worker; hereinafter the same applies) in order to verify their driver qualificationspursuant to Article 19-4, paragraph 1 of the Act. However, this shall not apply in cases where the driver qualifications of small parcel delivery service workers, etc. can be verified through a driver qualification verification system pursuant to Article 19-4, paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 「도로교통법」 제85조에 따른 운전면허증 사본(운전면허증을 직접 제시하지 않는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. A copy of the driver's license pursuant to Article 85 of the Road Traffic Act (only applicable when the driver's license is not presented in person)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「도로교통법 시행규칙」 제129조의2에 따른 운전경력증명서
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate of driving history pursuant to Article 129-2 of the Enforcement Rule of the Road Traffic Act

rows.source_ko: ② 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자 또는 영업점(이하 “소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등”이라 한다)은 법 제19조의4제2항에 따라 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격을 확인하기 위하여 「여객자동차 운수사업법」 제34조의3에 따른 운전자격확인시스템(이하 “운전자격확인시스템”이라 한다)을 이용하려는 경우에는 별지 제10호의6서식의 운전자격확인시스템 이용 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 1. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② If a certified small parcel delivery agency service provider or a branch office (hereinafter referred to as “certified small parcel delivery agency service provider, etc.”) intends to use the driver qualification verification system pursuant to Article 34-3 of the Passenger Transport Business Act (hereinafter referred to as the “driver qualification verification system”) to verify the driver qualifications of small parcel delivery agency service workers, etc., in accordance with Article 19-4 , Paragraph 2 of the Act, they shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for use of the driver qualification verification system in the form of Annex 10-6 , attaching the documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자: 제6조제2항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자 인증서 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Certified Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Provider: Copy of the Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Provider Certificate pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 영업점: 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자와 생활물류서비스에 관한 업무 계약을 체결하였음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Branch: Documents proving that a business contract regarding lifestyle logistics services has been concluded with a certified small parcel delivery agency business operator

rows.source_ko: ③ 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등은 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격을 확인하는 경우에는 제1항에 따라 제출된 서류를 직접 확인하거나 운전자격확인시스템을 통하여 확인하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a certified small parcel delivery agency service provider, etc. verifies the driver qualifications of a small parcel delivery agency service worker, etc., it shall do so by directly verifying the documents submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1 or by verifying through the driver qualification verification system.

rows.source_ko: ④ 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기간까지 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격을 확인해야 하며, 운전자격을 확인한 날을 기준으로 1개월마다(1개월이 되는 날이 속하는 달의 말일까지를 말한다) 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 운전자격을 확인해야 한다. <개정 2026. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ Certified small parcel delivery agency service providers, etc. shall verify the driver qualifications of small parcel delivery agency service employees, etc. by the period specified in each of the following subparagraphs, and shall verify the driver qualifications of small parcel delivery agency service employees, etc. every month from the date of verification (meaning until the last day of the month in which the one-month period falls). <Amended June 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등에 대하여 해당 목에서 정하는 기간까지
rows.text_en: 1. Certified Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Providers: With respect to small parcel delivery agency service workers, etc. classified according to each of the following items, until the period specified in each item

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제17조제1항에 따른 인증(이하 “소화물사업자인증”이라 한다)을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날까지 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하는 경우: 소화물사업자인증을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날까지
rows.text_en: a. In cases where a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc. is concluded with a small parcel delivery agency service worker, etc., by the 60th day from the date of receiving certification pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Small Parcel Business Operator Certification”): by the 60th day from the date of receiving Small Parcel Business Operator Certification

rows.source_ko: 나. 소화물사업자인증을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날의 다음 날 이후 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하는 경우: 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하기 전까지
rows.text_en: B. In cases where a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc. is concluded with a small parcel delivery service worker, etc. on or after the day following the 60th day from the date of obtaining small parcel business operator certification: Until the transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc. is concluded

rows.source_ko: 2. 영업점: 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하기 전까지
rows.text_en: 2. Branch Office: Until concluding a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc., with small parcel delivery service workers, etc.

[This Article newly inserted July 18, 2024]
[Moved from Article 7-2 <January 17, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의4(소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 보험 가입 확인 등) ① 법 제19조의5제1항에 따른 보험 또는 공제(이하 “보험등”이라 한다)는 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 갖춘 보험등을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-4 (Confirmation of Insurance Subscription for Small Parcel Delivery Service Workers, etc.) ① The insurance or mutual aid pursuant to Article 19-5, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “insurance, etc.”) refers to insurance, etc. that meets all the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 다른 사람이 사망하거나 부상한 경우에 피해자(피해자가 사망한 경우에는 손해배상을 받을 권리를 가진 자를 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)에게 「자동차손해배상 보장법 시행령」 제3조제1항 각 호에 따른 금액을 보장할 것
rows.text_en: 1. In the event that another person dies or is injured, guarantee the amount prescribed in each subparagraph of Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Automobile Liability Insurance Act to the victim (in cases where the victim has died, this refers to the person entitled to receive compensation for damages; hereinafter the same applies in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 다른 사람의 재물이 멸실되거나 훼손된 경우에 피해자에게 「자동차손해배상 보장법 시행령」 제3조제3항에 따른 금액을 보장할 것
rows.text_en: 2. In the event that another person's property is lost or damaged, guarantee the victim the amount pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Automobile Liability Insurance Act.

rows.source_ko: 3. 교통사고로 인하여 피해자에게 발생한 손해배상금 전액을 보상하는 경우로서 「교통사고처리 특례법」 제4조제2항에 따른 보험등일 것
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where the full amount of damages incurred by the victim due to a traffic accident is compensated, and the insurance, etc. shall be in accordance with Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Processing of Traffic Accidents.

rows.source_ko: ② 소화물배송대행인증사업자등은 법 제19조의5제1항에 따라 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 보험등 가입 여부를 확인하기 위하여 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등에게 다음 각 호의 서류의 제출을 요청할 수 있다. 다만, 법 제19조의5제3항에 따른 정보시스템(이하 “정보시스템”이라 한다)을 통하여 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 보험등 가입 여부를 확인할 수 있는 경우는 제외한다.
rows.text_en: ② A certified small parcel delivery agency business operator, etc., may request small parcel delivery service workers, etc., to submit the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs in order to verify whether they have subscribed to insurance, etc., pursuant to Article 19-5, Paragraph 1 of the Act. However, this shall not apply in cases where the subscription status of small parcel delivery service workers, etc. , can be verified through the information system pursuant to Article 19-5, Paragraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Information System”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 「자동차손해배상 보장법」 제5조에 따른 보험등의 가입증명서(자료 제출일을 기준으로 30일 이내에 발급된 서류로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of enrollment in insurance, etc. pursuant to Article 5 of the Automobile Liability Insurance Act (limited to documents issued within 30 days from the date of submission of materials)

rows.source_ko: 2. 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 해당 보험등에 따른 보상을 받을 수 있는 자격을 증빙하는 서류(자료 제출일을 기준으로 30일 이내에 발급된 서류로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving eligibility for compensation under the relevant insurance, etc. for small parcel delivery service workers, etc. (limited to documents issued within 30 days from the date of submission of materials)

rows.source_ko: ③ 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등은 법 제19조의5제1항에 따라 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 보험등 가입 여부를 확인하기 위하여 정보시스템을 이용하려는 경우에는 별지 제10호의7서식의 보험등 가입확인 정보시스템 이용 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where a certified small parcel delivery agency service provider, etc. intends to use an information system to verify whether small parcel delivery agency service workers, etc. are enrolled in insurance, etc. pursuant to Article 19-5, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for use of the insurance, etc. verification information system in the form of Annex 10-7 , attaching documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자: 제6조제2항에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스사업자 인증서 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Certified Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Provider: Copy of the Small Parcel Delivery Agency Service Provider Certificate pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 영업점: 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자와 생활물류서비스에 관한 업무 계약을 체결하였음을 증빙하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Branch Office: Documents proving that a business contract regarding lifestyle logistics services has been concluded with a certified small parcel delivery agency business operator

rows.source_ko: ④ 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기한까지 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등의 보험등 가입 여부를 확인해야 하며, 보험등이 만료되기 전까지 그 가입 여부를 재확인해야 한다. 다만, 보험등의 기간이 6개월 이상인 경우에는 3개월마다(3개월이 되는 날이 속하는 달의 말일까지를 말한다) 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Certified small parcel delivery agency service providers, etc., must verify whether small parcel delivery agency service workers, etc. have subscribed to insurance, etc. by the deadline specified in each of the following subparagraphs, and must reconfirm such subscription status before the insurance, etc. expires. However, if the period of insurance, etc. is 6 months or longer, verification must be performed every 3 months (until the end of the month in which the 3-month period falls).

rows.source_ko: 1. 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 기한까지
rows.text_en: 1. Certified Small Parcel Delivery Service Providers: By the deadline specified in each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 소화물사업자인증을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날 이전에 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하는 경우: 해당 인증을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날까지
rows.text_en: a. In cases where a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc. is concluded with a small parcel delivery service worker, etc., prior to the 60th day from the date of receiving the small parcel business operator certification: Until the 60th day from the date of receiving said certification

rows.source_ko: 나. 소화물사업자인증을 받은 날부터 60일이 되는 날 후에 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하는 경우: 해당 계약 등을 체결하기 전까지
rows.text_en: B. In cases where a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc. is concluded with a small parcel delivery service worker, etc. after the 60th day from the date of certification as a small parcel business operator: until said contract, etc. is concluded

rows.source_ko: 2. 영업점: 소화물배송대행서비스종사자등과 운송 위탁계약이나 근로계약 등을 체결하기 전까지
rows.text_en: 2. Branch Office: Until concluding a transportation consignment contract or employment contract, etc., with small parcel delivery service workers, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에도 불구하고 소화물배송대행서비스인증사업자등은 정보시스템의 장애, 보험사업자 또는 공제조합의 서류 발급 지연 등 불가피한 사유로 제4항에 따른 기한까지 보험등 가입 여부를 확인할 수 없는 경우에는 제4항에 따른 기한의 다음 날부터 영업일 기준 14일 이내에 확인할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Notwithstanding Paragraph 4, if a certified small parcel delivery service provider, etc. is unable to verify whether insurance, etc. has been subscribed by the deadline under Paragraph 4 due to unavoidable reasons such as a failure of the information system or a delay in the issuance of documents by an insurance business operator or mutual aid association, it may verify the information within 14 business days from the day following the deadline under Paragraph 4.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 2, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의5(소화물배송대행서비스종사자 교육) ① 법 제19조의6제1항에 따른 교통안전 교육에는 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-5 (Education for Small Parcel Delivery Service Workers) ① The traffic safety education under Article 19-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the contents of each of the following subparagraphs:

rows.source_ko: 1. 「생활물류서비스산업발전법」 및 「도로교통법」 등 관계 법령에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning relevant laws and regulations, such as the "Act on the Development of the Living Logistics Service Industry" and the "Road Traffic Act"

rows.source_ko: 2. 교통안전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning traffic safety

rows.source_ko: 3. 소화물 배송 요령에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning small parcel delivery procedures

rows.source_ko: 4. 운송수단에 대한 안전조치 및 사고수습조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning safety measures and accident response measures for means of transportation

rows.source_ko: 5. 「산업안전보건법 시행규칙」 별표 5 제4호가목에 따른 안전 보건 교육 내용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the content of safety and health education pursuant to Item 4, Subparagraph (a) of Annex 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Industrial Safety and Health Act

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조의6제1항에 따른 교통안전 교육의 교육시간은 3시간으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The duration of traffic safety education pursuant to Article 19-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be 3 hours.

[This Article newly inserted June 2, 2026]
[Enforcement Date: December 3, 2026] Article 7-5

rows.source_ko: 제8조(전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서) 법 제26조제3항 및 영 제23조제2항에 따라 전문인력 양성기관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제11호서식의 전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 국토교통부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Designation as a Professional Training Institution) Pursuant to Article 26 , Paragraph 3 of the Act and Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, any person who intends to be designated as a professional training institution shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for designation as a professional training institution in the form of Annex 11, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shallverify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육 인력ㆍ시설 및 설비의 확보 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Securing Educational Personnel, Facilities, and Equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육과정 및 교육내용이 포함된 교육계획서
rows.text_en: 3. Education plan including curriculum and educational content

rows.source_ko: 4. 운영경비 조달계획서 및 지원금 활용계획서
rows.text_en: 4. Operating Expense Procurement Plan and Grant Utilization Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 교육규정
rows.text_en: 5. Education Regulations

rows.source_ko: 제9조(생활물류서비스약관 신고서 등) 영 제30조제2항에 따른 생활물류서비스약관 신고서(변경신고서)는 별지 제12호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Report on Terms and Conditions for Living Logistics Services, etc.) The report on terms and conditions for living logistics services (report on change) pursuant to Article 30 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 12 .

rows.source_ko: 제10조(생활물류서비스 평가기준 등) ① 법 제35조제2항제6호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2025. 1. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Evaluation Standards for Living Logistics Services, etc.) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 35, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 6 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 17, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생활물류서비스의 신뢰성
rows.text_en: 1. Reliability of lifestyle logistics services

rows.source_ko: 2. 생활물류서비스의 친절성
rows.text_en: 2. Friendliness of lifestyle logistics services

rows.source_ko: 3. 생활물류서비스의 대응성
rows.text_en: 3. Responsiveness of Lifestyle Logistics Services

rows.source_ko: 4. 생활물류서비스 제공을 위한 물리적 환경의 적정성
rows.text_en: 4. Suitability of the physical environment for providing lifestyle logistics services

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 국토교통부장관이 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters determined by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

rows.source_ko: ② 국토교통부장관은 생활물류서비스에 대한 평가(이하 “서비스평가”라 한다)를 위해 필요하면 소비자에 대한 현장조사 등을 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2026. 9. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may conduct on-site investigations of consumers, etc., if necessary for the evaluation of living logistics services (hereinafter referred to as “service evaluation”). <Amended Sep. 15, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 매년 서비스평가 시행 1개월 전까지 평가대상ㆍ평가기간ㆍ평가일정ㆍ평가항목 등을 포함한 서비스평가계획을 수립하여 평가 시행 15일 전까지 서비스평가 대상 생활물류서비스사업자에게 통보해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall establish a service evaluation plan including the evaluation subjects, evaluation period, evaluation schedule, and evaluation items by one month prior to the implementation of the service evaluation each year, and notify the living logistics service providers subject to the service evaluation by 15 days prior to the implementation of the evaluation.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 서비스평가의 방법 및 절차 등 세부적인 사항은 국토교통부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters such as the method and procedure for service evaluation shall be determined by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(생활물류 쉼터의 설치ㆍ관리 등) ① 국토교통부장관 및 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제37조제1항에 따른 생활물류 쉼터를 설치 및 관리할 때에는 별표의 기준을 고려해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Installation and Management, etc. of Living Logistics Shelters) ① When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the heads of local governmentsinstall and manage living logistics shelters pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall take into consideration the standards set forth in the attached Table . <Amended Oct. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 국토교통부장관 및 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제37조제1항에 따른 생활물류 쉼터를 운영할 때에는 생활물류 쉼터를 이용하는 생활물류서비스종사자의 성별 특성을 고려해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② When operating a living logistics shelter pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the head of a local government shall consider the gender characteristics of living logistics service workers using the shelter. <Amended Oct. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제37조제2항제4호에서 “생활물류서비스종사자의 보호 및 복리 증진을 위한 사항으로서 국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”은 법 제10조에 따른 택배서비스 운송 위탁계약의 갱신 등에 관한 상담 지원을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 37, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport as matters for the protection and welfare promotion of workers in living logistics services” refers to counseling support regarding the renewal, etc. of consignment contracts for courier service transportation pursuant to Article 10 of the Act .
[Title amended Oct. 30, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(공제조합의 설립인가 신청서) 영 제37조제3항에 따른 공제조합 설립인가 신청서는 별지 제13호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Application for Approval of Establishment of Mutual Aid Association) The application for approval of the establishment of a mutual aid association pursuant to Article 37 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 13 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(수수료) 법 제47조제1항에 따른 수수료는 200만원 이하의 범위에서 국토교통부장관이 정하여 고시하는 기준에 따라 업무를 대행 또는 수탁한 기관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Fees) The fees pursuant to Article 47, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be determined and announced by the agency acting on behalf of or entrusted with the work in accordance with the standards determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, within a range of 2 million won or less .

rows.source_ko: 제14조(규제의 재검토) 국토교통부장관은 제7조의5에 따른 소화물배송대행서비스종사자 교육에 대하여 2026년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 1월 1일 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall review the validity of the education for small parcel delivery service workers under Article 7-5 every three years starting from January 1, 2026 (meaning before January 1 of every third year) and take measures such as improvements.
